t1_records.text: Sir! The parents' meeting starts in ten minutes — I need the records NOW!

p1_fees.text: I paid on M-Pesa on Monday — how can you not find the receipt?!

a1_reports.text: Sir! The education office wants the returns by Friday!

t2_where.text: Sir! Which file did you put in the drawer?!

p2_answer.text: Hello? HELLO? I can see you sitting there!

h2_feellike.text: Is running a school... supposed to feel like this?

c1_hardway.text: Sir... why are you doing all this the hard way?

t3_wait.text: Wait — ALL of it? In one place?

c3_idea.text: One dashboard. Marks, fees, timetables — everything's in there.

h5_suffering.text: And I've been suffering all this time?

t4_problem.text: Sir! The printer has jammed — AGAIN!
